legend.text:
What changes

• The Explore tab goes; the tabs read Chronicle · Navigate (the owner, Nov 22).
• On the walk screen, ready or walking, an "Explore" pill at the top right raises a full-width sheet over the walk's own map. It opens only on a tap.
• Raised, the sheet holds Explore's title, search, Plan an outing and the row of area cards. The map above shows the selected area's ring and its name; the walker, the trace and the route stay drawn.
• The strip stays below the sheet: Start, or the walk's time, distance and Pause, are always there.
• The camera, mic and note ride above the sheet's top edge, one tap away at every height (VISION: Capture is one tap away). At full height they float at the right edge over the card, which leaves them room.
• Walk to from the sheet sets the destination here (ready) or routes this walk (walking, NV10). Nothing leaves the screen.

What it does not do

• No count anywhere: presence is dots, familiarity in words, unfound places unnamed.
• No list of places still to find; no new colour; the pill is ink, the accent stays Start's.
• The sheet never rises by itself.

Choices drawn as recommended: the pill's place (top right, mirroring the chevron); two heights (the row, and full for a card); the captures floating over the full card. The alternatives row shows the other two.
